description: Runs of Code Engine jobs. submit starts a run of a job definition; list and get show status; events shows why a run failed. Identify a run with project_id and job_run_name. Call get_schema with name ce_job_run for every action's fields.

action.description: submit: Start a run of job_name; job_run_name optionally names the run. Needs job_name. | list: List runs, optionally only for job_name. | get: Get status of one run. Needs job_run_name. | events: Get platform events such as OOMKilled or image pull errors. Needs job_run_name. | resubmit: Run job_run_name again with the same config; new_run_name optionally names the new run. Needs job_run_name. | cancel: Stop and delete a run. Needs job_run_name.

job_run_name.description: Job run name, from ce_job_run action list.

namespace.description: Optional: project namespace (subdomain) override, if it cannot be auto-derived.

new_run_name.description: Optional name for the new job run

project_id.description: Project id or name, from ce_project action list.

name: ce_job_run
